title: Find the starting point in LL
stepTitle: Learn LinkedList [Single LL, Double LL, Medium, Hard Problems]
category: Learn LinkedList [Single LL, Double LL, Medium, Hard Problems]
problemStatement: Return the node where the cycle begins, or None.
intuition: If the distance from head to the cycle start is L and the meeting point is k into the cycle, then L and k are congruent modulo the cycle length. Restarting one pointer at the head makes both arrive at the start together.

approaches.title: Optimal: Floyd's two phases
approaches.idea: Detect the meeting point, then advance one pointer from the head at equal speed.
approaches.dryRun: Meeting happens inside the loop; walking one pointer from head and one from the meeting point converges at node 2
approaches.whyWorks: 2*(L + k) = L + k + m*C implies L = m*C - k, so both pointers cover equal distance to the entry.

commonMistakes: Comparing values rather than node identity
patternRecognition: Same math powers "find the duplicate number" in O(1) space
interviewInsight: Have the modular-arithmetic proof ready in one sentence — it is the standard follow-up.
